hints.content:
The inequality $6>x$  is read as $6$ is greater than $x$.  

So, $x$ must be less than $6$.
So, we need to graph all values that are less than $6$.

options.alt: A number line from negative 1 to 9 with evenly spaced tick marks in increments of 1. An open point is plotted at 6. A line running to the left starts at 6 and continues.

question.content:
**Choose the graph of the inequality  $6>x$.**
